risks.risk: Corrosion or hidden damage on the side/rear of the block not shown.
risks.proof: Photos of all sides of the engine, including the flywheel housing and oil pan.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the engine ID/serial/data plate showing model number.
Video of the engine starting and idling.
Photos from all sides (front, rear, both sides, top) showing turbo, alternator, starter, and wiring intact.
Photo of the oil dipstick and coolant reservoir levels.
response.reason: The seller's claimed model (Cummins QSB 6.7) cannot be read from the photo, and this model detail is essential to set a price; a plate/serial shot and a running-condition clip are needed before even a worst-case price can be assigned.
